G51.d: from ἀγνοέω; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming:--error.

G44.d: from the same as ἀγκάλη; a hook (as bent):--hook.

G283.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μιαίνω; unsoiled, i.e. (figuratively) pure:--undefiled.

G450.d: from ἀνά and ἵστημι; to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):--arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right).

G139.d: from αἱρέομαι; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion:--heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.

G64.d: from ἄγρα; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.

G412.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλαλέω; not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable:--unspeakable.

G254.d: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.

G194.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι; undiluted:--without mixture.

G408.d: from ἀνήρ and νῖκος; man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite:--Adronicus.

G465.d: from a compound of ἀντί and ἀλλάσσω; an equivalent or ransom:--in exchange.

G303.d: a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.):--and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through. In compounds (as a prefix) it often means (by implication) repetition, intensity, reversal, etc.

G125.d: of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.

G384.d: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of σκεῦος; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset:--subvert.

G329.d: from ἀνά and a compound of the base of ζῶον and πῦρ; to re-enkindle:--stir up.

G65.d: from ἄγριος and ἐλαία; an oleaster:--olive tree (which is) wild.

G276.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετατίθημι; unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability:--immutable(-ility).

G96.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and δόκιμος; unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally):--castaway, rejected, reprobate.

G298.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μωμάομαι; unblamable:--blameless.

G349.d: from ἀνά and κράζω; to scream up (aloud):--cry out.

G390.d: from ἀνά and στρέφω; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:--abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

G489.d: from a compound of ἀντί and μισθός; requital, correspondence:--recompense.

G193.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and κράτος; powerless, i.e. without self-control:--incontinent.

G306.d: middle voice from ἀνά and βάλλω; to put off (for oneself):--defer.

G333.d: from ἀνά and θεωρέω; to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively):--behold, consider.

G455.d: from ἀνά and (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications):--open.

G182.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καθίστημι; inconstant:--unstable.

G485.d: from a derivative of ἀντιλέγω; dispute, disobedience:--contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

G468.d: from ἀνταποδίδωμι; a requital (properly, the thing):--recompense.

G496.d: from ἀντί and πίπτω (including its alternate); to oppose:--resist.

G58.d: from (to gather; probably akin to ἐγείρω); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare:--market(-place), street.

G8.d: of Hebrew origin (אֶבְיָתָר); Abiathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.

G475.d: from ἀντί and διατίθεμαι; to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious:--that oppose themselves.

G445.d: from ἀνθύπατος; to act as proconsul:--be the deputy.

G376.d: from ἀνά (in the sense of intensity) and (maimed); crippled:--maimed.

G286.d: apparently a primary word; a lamb:--lamb.

G124.d: from Αἴγυπτος; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus:--Egyptian.

G222.d: from the same as Ἀλεξανδρεύς; Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria:--of Alexandria.

G180.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταπαύω; unrefraining:--that cannot cease.

G382.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἀριθμέω; unnumbered, i.e. without number:--innumerable.

G421.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of ἴχνος; not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable:--past finding out; unsearchable.

G482.d: from ἀντί and the middle voice of λαμβάνω; to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate:--help, partaker, support.

G53.d: from the same as ἅγιος; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect:--chaste, clean, pure.

G256.d: of Hebrew origin (compare חֶלֶף); Alphæus, an Israelite:--Alpheus.

G130.d: from αἷμα and a derivative of ἐκχέω; an effusion of blood:--shedding of blood.

G317.d: adverb from a derivative of ἀναγκάζω; compulsorily:--by constraint.

G243.d: a primary word; "else," i.e. different (in many applications):--more, one (another), (an-, some an-)other(-s, -wise).

G406.d: from ἀνήρ; manly; Andreas, an Israelite:--Andrew.

G309.d: from ἀναβλέπω; restoration of sight:--recovery of sight.

G22.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and γάμος; unmarried:--unmarried.

G142.d: a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare נָשָׂא) to expiate sin:--away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

G239.d: of Hebrew origin (imperative of הָלַל and יָהּ); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation:--alleluiah.

G296.d: from the base of ἀμφότερος and ὁδός; a fork in the road:--where two ways meet.

G295.d: from the base of ἀμφότερος and πόλις; a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia:--Amphipolis.

G392.d: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τάσσω; to arrange:--set in order.

G50.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and νοιέω; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination):--(be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

G352.d: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and κύπτω; to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated:--lift up, look up.

G492.d: from ἀντί and παρέρχομαι; to go along opposite:--pass by on the other side.
r: passed by on the other side

G324.d: from ἀνά and δέχομαι; to entertain (as a guest):--receive.

G474.d: from ἀντί and βάλλω; to bandy:--have.

G358.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἅλς; saltless, i.e. insipid:--X lose saltness.

G225.d: from ἀληθής; truth:--true, X truly, truth, verity.

G141.d: from the same as αἱρετίζω; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).

G433.d: from ἀνά and ἥκω; to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper:--convenient, be fit.

G289.d: from ἄμπελος and ἔργον; a vine-worker, i.e. pruner:--vine-dresser.

G27.d: from ἀγαπάω; beloved:--(dearly, well) beloved, dear.

G464.d: from ἀντί and ἀγωνίζομαι; to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"):--strive against.

G404.d: from ἀνά and ψύχω; properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve:--refresh.

G68.d: from ἄγω; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet:--country, farm, piece of ground, land.

G452.d: of Hebrew origin (חֲנַנְיָה); Annas (i.e. Ἀνανίας), an Israelite:--Annas.

G25.d: perhaps from (much) (or compare עֲגַב); to love (in a social or moral sense):--(be-)love(-ed). Compare φιλέω.

G348.d: from ἀνά and κόπτω; to beat back, i.e. check:--hinder.

G379.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἀπολογέομαι; indefensible:--without an excuse, inexcusable.

G272.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέλω; to be careless of:--make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard.

G109.d: from (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient):--air. Compare ψύχω.

G203.d: from ἄκρον and probably a modified form of (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:--not circumcised, uncircumcised (with ἔχω), uncircumcision.

G305.d: from ἀνά and the base of βάσις; to go up (literally or figuratively):--arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).

G326.d: from ἀνά and ζάω; to recover life (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)live again, revive.

G79.d: feminine of ἀδελφός; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically):--sister.

G147.d: adverb from αἰσχροκερδής; sordidly:--for filthy lucre's sake.

G89.d: adverb from ἀδιάλειπτος; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion):--without ceasing.

G273.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μέμφομαι; irreproachable:--blameless, faultless, unblamable.

G66.d: from ἀγρός; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce):--wild, raging.

G201.d: from ἀκροατής; an audience-room:--place of hearing.

G280.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέτρον; immoderate:--(thing) without measure.

G302.d: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty:--(what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contracted for ἐάν.

G429.d: from ἀνά and εὑρίσκω; to find out:--find.

G69.d: ultimately from Α (as negative particle) and ὕπνος; to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake:--watch.

G375.d: from ἀνά and πέμπω; to send up or back:--send (again).

G156.d: from the same as αἰτέω; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):--accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

G210.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἑκών; unwilling:--against the will.

G169.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of καθαίρω (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)):--foul, unclean.

G71.d: a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce:--be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

G322.d: from ἀνά and δεικνύω; to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint:--appoint, shew.

G491.d: from Ἀντιόχεια; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia:--of Antioch.

G2.d: of Hebrew origin (אַהֲרוֹן); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.

G442.d: from ἄνθρωπος; human:--human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men.

G192.d: from ἀκρατής; want of self-restraint:--excess, incontinency.

G419.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐξερευνάω; not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable:--unsearchable.

G175.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and καρπός; barren (literally or figuratively):--without fruit, unfruitful.

G153.d: from (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself):--be ashamed.

G449.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of νίπτω; without ablution:--unwashen.

G407.d: middle voice from ἀνήρ; to act manly:--quit like men.

G416.d: from ἄνεμος; to toss with the wind:--drive with the wind.

G18.d: a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):--benefit, good(-s, things), well. Compare καλός.

G216.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and λαλέω; mute:--dumb.

G232.d: from ἁλιεύς; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go a-fishing.

G5.d: of Chaldee origin (אַב); father as a vocative:--Abba.

G395.d: from ἀνατέλλω; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural):--dayspring, east, rising.

G170.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and καιρός (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion:--lack opportunity.

G414.d: comparative of a derivative of ἀνέχομαι; more endurable:--more tolerable.

G167.d: from ἀκάθαρτος; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:--uncleanness.

G74.d: from ἀγών; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish:--agony.

G360.d: from ἀνά and λύω; to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively):--depart, return.

G343.d: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and καλύπτω; to unveil:--open, (un-)taken away.

G173.d: probably from the same as ἀκμήν; a thorn:--thorn.

G373.d: from ἀνά and παύω; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:--take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.

G41.d: from ἅγιος; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state):--holiness.

G215.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of λαλέω; unspeakable:--unutterable, which cannot be uttered.

G411.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκδιηγέομαι; not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable:--unspeakable.

G171.d: adverb from the same as ἀκαιρέομαι; inopportunely:--out of season.

G72.d: reduplicated from ἄγω; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living:--manner of life.

G235.d: neuter plural of ἄλλος; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.

G120.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θυμός; to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened:--be dismayed.

G221.d: from (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria:--of Alexandria, Alexandrian.

G223.d: from the same as (the first part of) ἀλέκτωρ and ἀνήρ; man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man:--Alexander.

G439.d: from ἄνθραξ; a bed of burning coals:--fire of coals.

G461.d: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of ὀρθός; to straighten up:--lift (set) up, make straight.

G177.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of κατά and καλύπτω; unveiled:--uncovered.

G453.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of νοιέω; unintelligent; by implication, sensual:--fool(-ish), unwise.

G238.d: from ἄλλος and (to harangue (compare ἀγορά)); to allegorize:--be an allegory (the Greek word itself).

G330.d: from ἀνά and (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.

G443.d: from ἄνθρωπος and (to kill); a manslayer:--murderer. Compare φονεύς.

G227.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and λανθάνω; true (as not concealing):--true, truly, truth.

G3.d: of Hebrew origin (אֲבַדּוֹן); a destroying angel:--Abaddon.

G279.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μετανοέω; unrepentant:--impenitent.

G183.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατέχω; unrestrainable:--unruly.

G202.d: from (to listen; apparently an intensive of ἀκούω); a hearer (merely):--hearer.

G402.d: from ἀνά and χωρέω; to retire:--depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

G178.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατακρίνω; without (legal) trial:--uncondemned.

G7.d: of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיָּה); Abijah, the name of two Israelites:--Abia.

G93.d: from ἄδικος; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act):--iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

G166.d: from αἰών; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well):--eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

G122.d: from (a goat); belonging to a goat:--goat.

G85.d: from a derivative of (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind):--be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

G76.d: of Hebrew origin (אָדָם); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative):--Adam.

G179.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταλύω; indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:--endless.

G370.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἄξιος; unfit:--unworthy.

G380.d: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and πτύσσω; to unroll (a scroll or volume):--open.

G417.d: from the base of ἀήρ; wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth):--wind.

G483.d: from ἀντί and λέγω; to dispute, refuse:--answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.

G425.d: from ἀνίημι; relaxation or (figuratively) relief:--eased, liberty, rest.

G212.d: from ἀλαζών; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence:--boasting, pride.

G495.d: from ἀντί and πέραν; on the opposite side:--over against.

G196.d: superlative of (a derivative of the same as ἄκρον); most exact:--most straitest.

G261.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and μανθάνω; ignorant:--unlearned.

G218.d: from Α (as particle of union) and the base of λιπαρός; to oil (with perfume):--anoint.

G30.d: from (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of ἀγκάλη); a receptacle:--vessel.

G278.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μεταμέλλομαι; irrevocable:--without repentance, not to be repented of.

G355.d: from ἀνά and a form of the alternate of αἱρέομαι; properly, to use up, i.e. destroy:--consume.

G400.d: from ἀνά and φωνέω; to exclaim:--speak out.

G341.d: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός; to renovate:--renew.

G472.d: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ἔχω; to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for:--hold fast, hold to, support.

G1.d: of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha. Often used (usually , before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from ἄνευ) in the sense of privation; so, in many words, beginning with this letter; occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of ἅμα).

G396.d: from ἀνά and the base of τροπή; to overturn (figuratively):--overthrow, subvert.

G470.d: from ἀντί and ἀποκρίνομαι; to contradict or dispute:--answer again, reply against.

G163.d: from αἰχμάλωτος; to make captive:--lead away captive, bring into captivity.

G73.d: from ἄγω; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety:--conflict, contention, fight, race.

G367.d: of Hebrew origin (חֲנַנְיָה); Ananias, the name of three Israelites:--Ananias.

G494.d: from the same as Ἀντίπας; Antipatris, a place in Palestine:--Antipatris.

G42.d: from ἅγιος; sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality):--holiness.

G10.d: of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיהוּד); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.

G91.d: from ἄδικος; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically):--hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

G181.d: from ἀκατάστατος; instability, i.e. disorder:--commotion, confusion, tumult.

G437.d: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ὁμολογέω; to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise:--give thanks.

G246.d: from ἄλλος and φυλή; foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile:--one of another nation.

G337.d: from ἀνά and (the active of) αἱρέομαι; to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder:--put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.

G231.d: from ἅλς; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher:--fisher(-man).

G77.d: from Α (as negative particle); and δαπάνη; costless, i.e. gratuitous:--without expense.

G477.d: from a compound of ἀντί and τίθημι; opposition, i.e. a conflict (of theories):--opposition.

G431.d: from Α (as a particle of union) and an obsolete (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin:--sister's son.

G394.d: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τίθημι; to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound:--communicate, declare.

G466.d: from ἀντί and ἀναπληρόω; to supplement:--fill up.

G310.d: from ἀνά and βοάω; to halloo:--cry (aloud, out).

G436.d: from ἀντί and ἵστημι; to stand against, i.e. oppose:--resist, withstand.

G35.d: from Α (as negative particle) and γενεαλογέω; unregistered as to birth:--without descent.

G288.d: probably from the base of ἀμφότερος and that of ἅλων; a vine (as coiling about a support):--vine.

G152.d: from αἰσχύνομαι; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely):--dishonesty, shame.

G132.d: of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite:--Æneas.

G23.d: from (much) and (grief; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant:--be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

G150.d: from the same as αἰσχύνομαι; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal):--filthy.

G480.d: from ἀντί and κεῖμαι; to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to:--adversary, be contrary, oppose.

G476.d: from ἀντί and δίκη; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy):--adversary.

G99.d: from (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian):--Adria.

G487.d: from ἀντί and λύτρον; a redemption-price:--ransom.

G13.d: of Hebrew origin (compare חָגָב); Agabus, an Israelite:--Agabus.

G428.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and εὔθετος; not well set, i.e. inconvenient:--not commodious.

G486.d: from ἀντί and λοιδορέω; to rail in reply:--revile again.

G104.d: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly:--always, ever.

G420.d: from ἀνέχομαι and κακός; enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing:--patient.

G427.d: a primary particle; without:--without. Compare Α.

G59.d: from ἀγορά; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem:--buy, redeem.

G61.d: from ἄγω; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish):--draught.

G48.d: from ἁγνός; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally):--purify (self).

G353.d: from ἀνά and λαμβάνω; to take up:--receive up, take (in, unto, up).

G214.d: from ( a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang:--tinkle, wail.

G164.d: from (a spear) and a derivative of the same as ἅλωσις; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:--captive.

G409.d: from ἀνήρ and φόνος; a murderer:--manslayer.

G423.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐπιλαμβάνομαι; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable:--blameless, unrebukeable.

G86.d: from Α (as negative particle) and εἴδω; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls:--grave, hell.

G113.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal:--wicked.

G479.d: from ἀντί and καλέω; to invite in return:--bid again.

G107.d: of Hebrew origin (compare עַזּוּר); Azor, an Israelite:--Azorigin

G277.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετακινέω; immovable:--unmovable.

G257.d: probably from the base of εἱλίσσω; a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed):--floor.

G292.d: middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect:--defend.

G418.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as ἐνδέχεται; unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable:--impossible.

G430.d: middle voice from ἀνά and ἔχω; to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with:--bear with, endure, forbear, suffer.

G460.d: adverb from ἄνομος; lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law:--without law.

G205.d: from ἄκρον and (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.

G20.d: from ἀγαλλιάω; exultation; specially, welcome:--gladness, (exceeding) joy.

G332.d: from ἀνάθεμα; to declare or vow under penalty of execration:--(bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.

G111.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (statute; from the base of τίθημι); illegal; by implication, flagitious:--abominable, unlawful thing.

G446.d: from ἀντί and a superlative of ὑπέρ; instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul:--deputy.

G498.d: from ἀντί and the middle voice of τάσσω; to range oneself against, i.e. oppose:--oppose themselves, resist.

G356.d: from a compound of ἀνά and λόγος; proportion:--proportion.

G244.d: from ἀλλότριος and ἐπίσκοπος; overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs):--busybody in other men's matters.

G361.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἁμαρτάνω; sinless:--that is without sin.

G187.d: from the same as ἀκμήν; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:--be fully ripe.

G422.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐπί and αἰσχύνομαι; not ashamed, i.e. irreprehensible: --that needeth not to be ashamed.

G31.d: from ἄγγελος; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.

G399.d: from ἀνά and φέρω; to take up (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).
